title: Original Apollo 11 Guidance Computer source code for command and lunar modules
summary: This repository contains the original Apollo 11 Guidance Computer (AGC) source code used in both the Command Module (Comanche055) and Lunar Module (Luminary099), the software that guided the 1969 Moon landing mission.
problem_solved: Provided real-time guidance, navigation, and flight control for the Apollo spacecraft during the first Moon landing mission.
why_valuable: This is a historically significant piece of software engineering that represents one of humanity's greatest technological achievements, preserved as an educational resource for future generations.
